dedupe_keys.name: apartment vacancy and rental cost survey

description: The Government of Alberta conducts an annual survey of multi-family rental dwellings in rural communities with populations of 1,000 to 9,999 and at least 30 rental units. The metadata identifies building type, unit type, unit counts, rental rates and vacancies. The continuing collection lists an Excel dataset covering the 2022–2024 surveys, with a data dictionary, and PDF report editions from 2014 through 2024 with gaps in the returned descriptors. The survey is conducted between May and August each year. Related archived 2022 and 2023 table packages are grouped here as earlier components of the same source-named series; each has ten XLSX table descriptors. These are observations of building stock and occupancy. A specific simulation application is not stated. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue binds the continuing and archived packages to exact Alberta identifiers. It labels them Open Government Licence - Alberta. Original Alberta pages returned HTTP 403 to HEAD checks. Workbook and report contents, actual download access and costs remain untested; complete historical coverage is not claimed.
